prompt.description: What to make, for Text to 3D. Used when no images are given.
examples: a weathered bronze statue of a fox sitting upright
prompt.title: Prompt

images.description: One image of the object, or two to four views of it with the front view first. jpg, png or webp.
images.title: Images

should_texture.description: Texture the mesh. Off returns the bare mesh and costs less.
should_texture.title: Should Texture

enable_pbr.description: Add metallic, roughness and normal maps. Needs should_texture.
enable_pbr.title: Enable Pbr

texture_prompt.description: Text that guides the texture. Takes precedence over texture_image.
texture_prompt.title: Texture Prompt

texture_image.description: An image whose look the texture should follow.
texture_image.title: Texture Image

geometry_resolution.description: Mesh detail. 2k and 4k cost 5 credits more; 4k is not available with several images.
geometry_resolution.title: Geometry Resolution

target_polycount.description: Polygon count when remeshing, 100 to 300000. Empty: 30000.
target_polycount.title: Target Polycount

pose_mode.description: Put a character in an A or T pose. Empty: as given.
pose_mode.title: Pose Mode

image_enhancement.description: Let Meshy clean up the input images first.
image_enhancement.title: Image Enhancement

auto_size.description: Scale the model to a real-world size.
auto_size.title: Auto Size

origin_at.description: Where the origin sits with auto_size.
origin_at.title: Origin At

moderation.description: Have Meshy refuse harmful prompts and images.
moderation.title: Moderation
